data.name: NotFound
data.value: Inventory count order was not found.

data.name: DraftOnly
data.value: This action is only available for draft or planned count orders.

data.name: InvalidRequest
data.value: Inventory count data is invalid or incomplete.

data.name: LocationNotCountable
data.value: The selected location is outside the warehouse, inactive, or not eligible for counting.

data.name: ActiveCountConflict
data.value: At least one selected location already belongs to another active count task.

data.name: EmptyScope
data.value: No eligible location or stock balance was found in the selected scope.

data.name: ConcurrencyConflict
data.value: The count order was changed by another user. Refresh and try again.

data.name: PermissionDenied
data.value: You do not have permission for this inventory count action.

data.name: Released
data.value: Inventory count order was released with its snapshot and location tasks.
